news.title: COP30 Climate Summit preparations and global climate actions
news.text: The COP30 Climate Summit (2026 global climate conference) is the 30th annual Conference of the Parties (COP) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change. Scheduled for 2026 in Belém, Brazil, the summit will bring together world leaders, scientists, and activists to accelerate global efforts toward limiting climate change.

news.title: NASA and international space research updates
news.text: NASA is making major progress in Moon and Mars missions with advanced satellite and space technologies. Scientists are developing modern systems for better communication and space research. International space agencies are also working together to improve future space exploration and scientific discoveries. Recent missions focus on studying planets, space environments, and future human travel to space. These developments are expected to support future technological growth worldwide.

news.title: Global AI Technology Growth and International Collaboration
news.text: Countries are investing heavily in Artificial Intelligence (AI) for healthcare, education, and business development.International organizations and technology companies are focusing on safe, ethical, and secure AI implementation.

news.title: India restricts Bay of Bengal airspace
news.text: India issued a NOTAM (Notice to Airmen) restricting airspace over the Bay of Bengal from May 6 to May 9 due to possible missile testing activity. Reports suggest the test may involve a long-range strategic missile as part of India’s defense modernization program. The restricted zone extends from the Odisha coast into the Indian Ocean to ensure the safety of civilian flights during the operation

news.title: IMD issues heatwave and rain alerts across India
news.text: The India Meteorological Department has issued heatwave alerts for several northern and central states due to rising temperatures. Some regions are also expected to receive heavy rainfall and thunderstorms this week. Authorities advised people to stay safe and follow precautions during extreme weather conditions.

news.title: Indian Premier League
news.text: Indian Premier League witnessed several thrilling matches this week as teams battled for important points in the playoff race. Royal Challengers Bengaluru secured a crucial win against Lucknow Super Giants, while Kolkata Knight Riders and Mumbai Indians also delivered strong performances. Fans enjoyed exciting batting displays, close finishes, and impressive bowling performances throughout the week.

news.title: Tamil Nadu Election Results 2026
news.text: Tamil Nadu witnessed a major political change in the 2026 Assembly Elections as Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam led by Vijay emerged as the single largest party. TVK won 108 seats in the 234-member Assembly, while Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam secured 59 seats and All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam won 46 seats. Since the majority mark is 118 seats, discussions for alliance support and government formation are currently taking place across the state.

news.title: Tamil Nadu Increases Water Release to Manage Summer Demand
news.text: Tamil Nadu government has increased water release from major reservoirs to support irrigation and drinking water needs during the summer season. The decision was taken due to rising temperatures and increasing water demand across the state. Authorities are also ensuring proper water distribution to avoid shortages during peak summer months.

news.title: Chennai Metro Rail Phase-2 Project Update
news.text: Chennai Metro Rail Phase-2 construction work is progressing across several parts of Chennai. Officials stated that the expansion will help reduce traffic congestion and improve daily public transportation in the city. The project is expected to strengthen Chennai’s transport system and support future urban development.
